name: Modern GPU-Accelerated CSS Animations, View Transitions, and Scroll-Driven Timelines
description: High-fidelity CSS animation and styling scenario evaluating an agent's capability to architect performant GPU-composited CSS animations, scroll-driven timelines (animation-timeline: scroll() and view()), discrete property transitions with @starting-style, and smooth document View Transitions.
instructions:
You are tasked with implementing the modern CSS animations architecture in `src/styles/animations.css`, `src/styles/view-transitions.css`, and `src/components/animated-carousel.ts`.

### Task Objectives:
1. **GPU-Accelerated Compositing & Scroll-Driven Timelines (`src/styles/animations.css`)**:
   - Implement performant 60fps CSS keyframes utilizing only composite properties (`transform`, `opacity`, `filter`). Strictly avoid animating layout/reflow properties (`height`, `top`, `margin`).
   - Author scroll-driven animation rules using `animation-timeline: scroll(root)` and `animation-timeline: view()` with custom animation ranges (`entry 0% cover 100%`).
   - Implement discrete property transitions for entry/exit animations using `@starting-style` and `transition-behavior: allow-discrete`.

2. **Document View Transitions (`src/styles/view-transitions.css`)**:
   - Configure smooth cross-fade and morphing animations for `::view-transition-old(root)` and `::view-transition-new(root)`.
   - Define named view transition identities (`view-transition-name`) for cards and hero images.

3. **Interactive Animation Controller (`src/components/animated-carousel.ts`)**:
   - Implement `AnimatedCarouselController` triggering document View Transitions via `document.startViewTransition()`.
   - Honor accessibility user settings with `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` fallbacks.
   - Measure animation frame rate using `requestAnimationFrame` delta tracking.

4. **Type Safety & Clean Code**:
   - Maintain strict TypeScript type annotations, readonly property interfaces, and zero any annotations.

judgeRubrics.name: Modern CSS Animation Architecture & GPU Efficiency
judgeRubrics.description: Evaluates the agent's proficiency in authoring hardware-accelerated CSS animations, scroll-driven timelines, discrete popover transitions with @starting-style, and View Transitions API integration.

criteria.1: Animates layout properties causing paint/reflow thrashing, ignores reduced motion, or omits scroll-driven animation features.
criteria.3: Implements basic keyframe animations and simple view transitions, but misses scroll-driven timelines or proper starting-style rules.
criteria.5: Masterful CSS animation architecture: pure composited transform3d/opacity animations, scroll/view timeline integrations, flawless View Transitions with named elements, and full accessibility compliance.
